reviews.text:
Brilliantly happy with everything. Treated a medium-sized Cobberdog for cruciate ligament damage, where surgery was the option. Laser and PRP. The dog was limping category 4/5 after a trauma. Now after two months he is not limping.
Good atmosphere, good information and knowledgeable veterinarian. Recommended!

We went here on the recommendation of another dog owner. We had previously been to Petrus and Evidensia. Our dog has been suffering from back pain for about 6 months and we have only been given lots of pills by other vets. Finally we were welcomed by a vet. After an MRI we were told that the dog had three small prolapses. We are now on our 6th treatment with laser, which has worked like a miracle!
We are very happy with both the treatment and the follow-up.
We cannot recommend this clinic enough!

Our dog has undergone two operations and several check-ups due to tumors in several udders. We are very satisfied with Frogner Veterinary Clinic through all of this. We have always felt well taken care of, and they have been very good at making arrangements for the dog.
The dog no longer has any signs of illness today.

I highly recommend Laxmi and Frogner Dyreklinikk. Laxmi has treated two of my cats, the first many years ago and before she started the clinic. He had an acute and serious injury to the musculoskeletal system (paraplegic/paralyzed after prolapse), and he was finally able to walk again. The last cat has osteoarthritis and spondylosis.

Laxmi has a completely unique combination of knowledge, thoroughness and care. I am overwhelmed by how much better my "arthrosis cat" is now. We tried a combination of different treatments, and everything was covered by the insurance. I had hoped for some improvement, but was certainly not prepared for how incredibly much better and more mobile he would become.

It means a lot to have a veterinarian in whom you have such great trust, both professionally and personally. Laxmi asks the important questions, takes her time, explains (for nerds like me who want to understand and learn), closely monitors how it actually works and develops, and meets both cat and owner with warmth and respect. No assembly line experience like you sometimes get at larger chains. I am very grateful for all the help we have received, and we will be back. ❤️

We are incredibly happy to have such a skilled veterinarian like Laxmi nearby. She is caring, kind and very knowledgeable, and meets both dogs and owners with great patience. She is good at explaining and conveys a sense of security that means a lot when our dog has had health challenges.

Everyone we have met at Frogner Dyreklinikk has been warm, welcoming and helpful. Perhaps the most telling thing is that our dog is never afraid to come back, despite necessary examinations and treatments. On the contrary, she wants to go in every time we pass by! We always feel in safe and good hands, and can highly recommend the clinic. 🤍
The best and safest place to go. Everyone here is great, and after visiting both owner and veterinarian Laxmi and veterinarian Tov, we are very happy with the treatment and help for our 3 dogs. ❤️
Very friendly and great service, Lovely décor. Once you come you will make this place your primary veterinarian.

We had a great experience with this clinic when our dog, Mochi, needed care.

The staff is always friendly, attentive, and professional throughout all the visits.
Special mention to Dr. Laxmi: she took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure Mochi was comfortable and well cared for.

We're very grateful for the excellent treatment and would happily recommend this clinic to other pet owners.

I would like to share the really positive experience I had at the clinic.

On Monday evening, I came home late and noticed my cat was behaving very strangely — her head was tilted to one side, she seemed disoriented, was not responding normally, and could barely keep her balance while walking. I was extremely worried, so I went to the veterinary clinic Petrus, where they recommended that I see the neurologist Laxmi at Frogner Dyreklinikk.

I was able to get an appointment there already on Tuesday, which was such a relief. From the moment I arrived, the team was kind, professional, and reassuring. Laxmi gave an excellent diagnosis, clearly explained what my cat could have, and carefully went through the treatment options with me.
I decided to proceed with the treatment, and we quickly started seeing improvements. Just three days later, my cat was behaving completely normally again! I truly believe they saved my cat.

Thank you so much to the entire team for your incredible work, patience, care, and dedication. ❤️❤️
I was recommended to this clinic, and Im happy that I came with my puppy. Very direct and profesional nurses and doctors. My Schnappi loved the attention 😄 …
Incredibly skilled and caring veterinarians, animal caretakers and assistants. You really feel taken care of here when you come to visit with your four-legged family member ❤️

The founder Laxmi has the biggest heart and has treated our furry babies with so much care, love and attention to detail 💕... that we could never repay. Her staff is kind and attentive, and we have felt safe and heard. …

Ordered dental cleaning for my dog ​​during a promotion at Frogner Dyreklinikk. After the treatment, I was told by a vet that several teeth had to be pulled, that the dog must be in a lot of pain (even though he showed no signs of this and was still eating hard things), and that the vet did not have time to give a status. Two days later I received an email from the vet that six teeth had to be removed – shocking.

I had a bad feeling and got a second opinion at another reputable vet clinic: only two teeth had to be pulled, and the price was only a quarter of Frogner Dyreklinikk's offer. I felt cheated. It seems that promotions are used to attract customers, and then suggest an unnecessary and expensive treatment. We will not be back, and always recommend getting a second opinion here.

feels strange.... says it takes several weeks from the time the HD images are taken until they can be sent to NKK.... at other clinics the images arrive the same day they are taken, and it rarely takes more than a couple of days before a response from NKK is available... -- very regrettable with such "lies"!!!!
Always welcome Darth and Iana ❤️
Very good and nice staff. My dog ​​Teis really enjoys it there. 😀🐶 …

Hi Yann,
Thank you so much for the reviews💜 …
Recommended! Very skilled and accommodating. Our dog received very good follow-up and Laxmi diagnosed a rare disease.

I recently moved to Frogner and my cat unfortunately got sick. Frogner veterinary clinic has very professional staff at their fingertips. My cat received great treatment and everything was done so professionally and it was a great experience for my cat, even though she was sick. Recommended!

Visited Frogner Dyreklinikk with my one-year-old dog Oreo for a health check. The clinic is bright, clean, and welcoming, located conveniently along Frognerveien.

We were met by Laxmi, a highly experienced veterinarian with over 20 years of expertise. She explained everything clearly, making me feel comfortable.

They offer a wide range of services — from general check-ups and diagnostics to orthopedic and rehabilitation treatments — which makes it easy to handle everything in one place.

Prices are reasonable, and having a stable team provides a level of trust. For pet owners who consider their animals as family, having a reliable, nearby clinic is very reassuring.

Incredible experience getting our little guy’s teeth cleaned. They went above and beyond, were so sweet, and even trimmed his nails free of charge while he was still asleep. We will definitely be back!

We got to know the clinic via TikTok and I wish I had discovered Laxmi much earlier 🤩 we have been going back and forth to different vets for 2 years without success. Laxmi managed to figure out the problem already on the first visit. She manages to create a chemistry and security with both the animals and the owners and it is obvious that she is passionate about what she does. Mira is on the road to recovery thanks to Laxmi.
Friendly and helpfull staff. One of best vets I ever experienced

I would like to share my experience with the treatment of a dog at the clinic, and I am sincerely disappointed and concerned about several matters that I believe should be addressed.

We informed that we are not the owners of the dog, but are looking after it, but despite this, the dog was sedated and some assessments were carried out without our or the owner's explicit consent. We were not clearly informed of all the costs associated with the recommended tests and measures before payment, which made it difficult to get an overview of the expenses.

The patient record contains information that I do not recognize, and some allegations describe that we have threatened or been rude, which we have not stated.

We were asked to sign documents that contained information about anesthesia, but emphasized that we did not have the authority to sign for treatment or measures on the dog; the documents were only supposed to include the dog's information, such as the last meal.

During the examination, X-rays and cytology were suggested and strongly encouraged, which I felt was unnecessary given the dog's small wound and the context I had explained, and we felt pressured to perform these examinations.

We were billed for a consultation that was in practice a start-up appointment for the next day, and we were not given a clear overview of the costs before payment. After requesting a specification of the costs, we were met with accusations of being significantly rude to the assistant, and the medical record describes us as rude and threatening, which is not consistent with our behavior or statements. We attempted to have the expenses reassessed and the medical record corrected, but experienced a lack of understanding and misrepresentation of the sequence of events in the medical record.

This raises concerns for patient and owner protection as well as for correct medical record keeping and consent management in the clinic.

The wound improved with treatment with ointment and protection to prevent licking, and the condition improved.

Based on this experience, I will not use the clinic again or recommend them to other pet owners.

Thankyou so much Dennis !
Always welcome🫶🙏🏼 …

Amilo, a 10-year-old American Cocker Spaniel, had partially torn his cruciate ligament while playing. He first went to the local vet for an X-ray and was referred to an orthopedist at Evidensia Oslo Animal Hospital. I was recommended a major surgical procedure (TPLO) due to a mild patellar luxation. This is both an extensive and often painful operation for the dog. I was advised about Laxmi and Frogner Dyreklinikk and decided to get a second opinion.

First, we had to take new X-rays since the ones I had were not good enough to determine the extent of the damage to the cruciate ligament. Laxmi recommended PRP. This is a treatment where concentrated amounts of growth factors/protein from the dog's blood are injected into the injury. In Amilo's case: both the damaged cruciate ligament and the patella. In addition, he received laser treatment. This was done under anesthesia. He showed no particular signs of pain immediately afterwards, except for some soreness and wheezing. After two weeks of rest, there was no limping. We have been in for 3 more laser treatments, and now - 1 month after the PRP injection he is completely healthy. We are still taking it easy, but everything indicates that the injury is cured 🙏🐶

It is absolutely incredible that such a relatively simple and not least painless treatment was a very good alternative to a comprehensive, painful and not least expensive surgery. From the start until now we have received superb help and customer service where we feel safe and well taken care of.

I am infinitely grateful to Laxmi, the team and what they have done for us. Thank you very much 🌸🙏 to everyone who has animals with joint problems, stiffness, arteritis and all other problems with the musculoskeletal system: Please go to Frogner Dyreklinikk - for both the animal's and your own sake!
